day_line: The sun on a Dragon day. Bold and bright: good for big ideas and leading the room, easy to promise too much.

lines.Yang Wood: Tuesday has extra spark for you. Wear the bright shirt to work.
lines.Yin Wood: Your ideas come out well today. Share one in the meeting, not after it.
lines.Yang Fire: Your people are fired up today. Team up on the big task; finish by six.
lines.Yin Fire: Someone shines loudly today. Let them; your steady glow lasts longer.
lines.Yang Earth: A wise thought arrives today. Sit with it over lunch before you decide.
lines.Yin Earth: Warm help reaches you today. Say yes when someone offers to check your work.
lines.Yang Metal: The heat is on today. Start the hardest task at nine, not at four.
lines.Yin Metal: Your polish gets noticed today. Present the final version; skip the apologies.
lines.Yang Water: A big chance rises today. Put your hand up first, then plan.
lines.Yin Water: Steady money wins today. Book the year-end trip at the early-bird price.
